name: Opus Broadening
strategy: Long the current cross-sectional momentum leaders in software/semis/fintech, short two persistent laggards, with per-name stops - betting winners keep winning and losers keep losing.
novelty: A single-name cross-sectional momentum book: concentrates in stocks with the strongest trailing 3-6 month trends and shorts the worst, harvesting dispersion continuation. The opposite driver from R1/R2, which bet on dispersion COMPRESSION (breadth/laggards catching up).

positions.thesis: +155% 12m semis momentum, best recent persistence among semis.
Accelerating fintech, strongest 3m in the leader set (+36%).
Deepest persistent downtrend (-45% 6m); doubles as risk-off hedge.
Sharp momentum breakdown (-37% 3m), the software laggard.

backtest.notes: Beat SPY in 5 of 6 windows including both stress windows; honest failure mode is momentum whipsaw (2023H2). Universe carries survivorship bias; point-to-point returns.

outlook: Momentum leadership intact through mid-2026; main risk is factor reversal, cushioned by shorts and 18-25% stops.
